<thought>Since searching with specific broken functional groups returned no templates, I will perform a broader search for any template that forms a C‑C double bond on the target cinnamic acid molecule. This should retrieve the Doebner modification template, after which I can obtain its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
